name: ZOUR x BITEZ Micros 3,000MG Gummies - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Cherry Watermelon
description: Sweet fruits collide in this next-level collab between Ocho Extracts and Zour Stash. Juicy cherry meets refreshing watermelon in a sweet, fruity pairing that tastes like summer candy. Each 500mg gummy features our signature Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend—half the punch of the original BITEZ for those who want a smoother, more manageable ride. With 6 per bag (3,000mg total), it’s the perfect combo of mouthwatering flavor and balanced potency.
